pilot.rule: smallest epochs within 0.5 accuracy points of the best grid cell (mean over the two pilot tasks), then the best learning rate at those epochs

probe.test: 1,000 validation images x 5 presentations, a ~ N(0,1)

manifest.experiment: E6, trust made to measure (protocol section 12)

keys.image: index in the CIFAR-10 test set
keys.z_H: person H: plus network, mu = 1, half A
keys.z_M: log-odds of each machine on its own (not the sum with H), shape (7, N), rows in the order of `machines`; for a branch machine z_M0 + z_branch
keys.val_*: the same on validation (val_image: CIFAR-10 training index)

manifest.layout: each image appears 5 times in a row (np.repeat), with independent frames
manifest.machine_training_frame: a ~ N(0, 2), independent of the class

machines.M0: cross-entropy on half B, as M_0 of E2, E2 bis and E2 ter
machines.M0plus: a copy of M0 fine-tuned on half B with cross-entropy: 10 epochs, learning rate the pilot's divided by 5 (0.02), cosine from it to zero
machines.Mdue: a copy of M0 fine-tuned as M0plus (same seed, batch order, crops, flips and frames); loss: its cross-entropy plus the binary cross-entropy of the summed log-odds (out1 - out0) + z_H, as in E2 ter
machines.Mramo_w: M0 frozen (eval mode) plus a branch: a new network that sees the framed image with its interior set to zero, trained from scratch with the pilot's epochs, learning rate and one-cycle schedule on the binary cross-entropy of z_H + w * (z_M0 + z_branch), H and M0 frozen, whole framed presentation, no gradient; recorded cue z_M0 + z_branch. One branch per w in [0.5, 1.0, 2.0, 4.0]; the branches share seed, batch order, crops, flips and frames

manifest.frame: the outer 2-pixel border of all three channels is set to a * delta, in normalised units (after per-channel normalisation), applied after crop and flip, without clipping
manifest.torch_seeds: the labels of E2 ter on new seeds: H and M0 crc32('rephase/<task>/s<seed>/<H|M>') & 0x7fffffff; M0plus and Mdue crc32('rephase/<task>/s<seed>/ter'); every branch crc32('rephase/<task>/s<seed>/ramo')

hyperparameters.network: Net of turing-meter experiments/angle-between-errors/gpu/silicon.py with a 2-way head: conv3x3 48-96, maxpool, 96-192, maxpool, 192, global average pool, linear; BatchNorm and ReLU after every convolution
hyperparameters.optimiser: SGD, Nesterov momentum 0.9, weight decay 5e-4, one-cycle schedule (PyTorch OneCycleLR defaults), bf16 autocast
hyperparameters.augmentation: random 32x32 crop of the image reflect-padded by 4 pixels, random horizontal flip

deviations: shared GPU: the driver stopped twice to give the GPU back to another user and started again when it was free. Three sessions on 2026-11-19, UTC: 09:49 to 10:15, 10:19 to 11:27, 19:20 to 20:13. A unit is written when it ends; the units under way at a stop were run again from the start, with the same seeds. stage_time is the last session only: the seconds of each unit are in unit_seconds
18 units were written in the first session (the first training started at 09:55:39 UTC), 7 in the second
environment built again for these runs: numpy 2.5.5 (E1 to E5: 2.5.4); python, torch, torchvision, CUDA and cuDNN as in E1 to E5

settings.peak: middle, in ln w, of the weights where Tu^2 - 1 is at least 0.9 of its maximum; the weight of the maximum where a crossing is outside the grid
settings.differences: machine minus M0plus, paired on the same resamples

F1.rule: at standardized weight 1, d_a of the pair with the branch built for weight 1 minus d_a of the pair with M0plus: interval above zero in every seed, in >= 3 tasks of 5

F2.rule: the same at face value (raw log-odds added, weight 1)

F3.rule: at standardized weight 8 the pair with M0plus is the more sensitive: interval of (partner minus soloist) below zero in every seed, in >= 3 tasks of 5

F4.rule: at face value the pair (H, M0plus) is less sensitive than M0plus alone (interval below zero in every seed, in >= 3 tasks of 5), and the pair with the branch built for weight 1 is not: median of (pair minus M0plus alone) >= -0.05

F5.rule: the raw weight at which the pair (H, Mramo_w) peaks is, in median over the units, within a factor 1.5 of w for w = 0.5, 1 and 2, and the median over the units of the rank correlation between w and the peak, over the four branches, is >= 0.9

F6.rule: tuned turing of (H, Mramo_w) over that of (H, M0plus), median over the units, within [0.97, 1.03] for each of the four weights

F7.rule: the machine alone is worth less the lower the weight it is built for: median rank correlation between w and d_a alone >= 0.9, and the branch built for 0.5 is less sensitive alone than M0plus, interval below zero in every seed, in >= 3 tasks of 5
